description: This is a Java test class that verifies the behavior of VertxBasedHealthCheckServer, including its configuration with secure and insecure endpoints, port settings, and health check registration. The tests utilize the Vertx testing framework and involve starting the server, making HTTP requests to health check endpoints, and validating responses.

classes.name: VertxBasedHealthCheckServerTest
classes.description: Test suite for VertxBasedHealthCheckServer, including configuration, startup, health check endpoints, and cleanup.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup after each test, stopping the server if it is running.

methods.name: testHealthCheckServerWithNoBindAddressFailsToStart
methods.description: Verifies that the server fails to start with no bind address provided.

methods.name: testHealthCheckServerWithInsecureEndpoint
methods.description: Tests server startup and health check endpoints with an insecure port.

methods.name: testHealthCheckServerWithSecureEndpoint
methods.description: Tests server startup and health check endpoints with a secure port.

methods.name: testHealthCheckServerWithSecureAndInsecureEndpoint
methods.description: Tests server with both secure and insecure ports enabled simultaneously.

methods.name: registerHealthChecks
methods.description: Registers dummy health check resources for liveness and readiness endpoints.

methods.name: checkHealth
methods.description: Sends a GET request to the specified health endpoint and verifies a 200 OK response.

methods.name: getWebClient
methods.description: Creates a WebClient configured for secure or insecure communication with the server.
